My Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2021/IR/382. Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No.: RUW/LAN/ACQTN/A2/278. By virtue of the powers vested in me by Proviso (a) to Section 38 of Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, do hereby direct the Acquiring Officer or any other officer authorized by him referred to in Paragraph I of the schedule to take immediate possession of the land specified in the corresponding entry in Paragraph II of that Schedule. K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,09th April, 2025.
I. Acquiring Officer.– Divisional Secretary, Ruwanwella.

II. 01. Lot ‘A’ – Mahakanda Janapadaya– Extent: 0.0432 Hectare North: Lot No. 19 of P. P. කෑ. 3791; East: Mahakanda Janapadaya claimed by T. A.
